applicabilityBasis.summary: sky.money USDS Flagship is a yield-bearing Morpho VaultV2 ERC-4626 strategy share over USDS. Sky.money documents variable market-driven lending returns, possible principal losses and liquidity-dependent withdrawals. Morpho documents asset reporting across lending positions and receipt-token redemption. This share represents a changing claim on vault assets, without a fixed monetary-value issuer redemption obligation or fixed-dollar share value under GENIUS Act section 2(22).

genius.notes: This assessment concerns the vault-share token and the tracked payment-stablecoin issuer-authorization model only. The underlying stablecoin has a separate assessment. No GENIUS approval or exemption, securities-law determination, or blanket exclusion from other regulatory obligations is asserted. No legal fiat-redemption issuer is established by the product documentation, so issuerEntity is omitted. The reviewed exact deployed contract is 0xe15fcc81118895b67b6647bbd393182df44e11e0 on Ethereum, with constructor asset 0xdC035D45d973E3EC169d2276DDab16f1e407384F. Sky.money is identified as curator; curation and underlying token issuance remain distinct roles.
